project_title: TOD Next Action Selection Competency V1
goal: TOD must always select a candidate successor action after completed, blocked, failed, rejected, or superseded work.
why_it_matters: Execution cannot improve enough if TOD does not know what to do next. A perfect worker sitting idle is still idle.

input.momentum: Moving, Waiting, Blocked, Abandoned, Completed, Stale, Needs Review.
input.completion_pressure: Accepted, Acceptance Open, Needs Acceptance, Close or Split.
input.scope_state: Scope Stable, Scope Watch, Scope Expanded.
input.prior_outcomes: Recent completed, blocked, failed, rejected, superseded, rescued, or auto-intervened outcomes.

training_record_shape.lane: planning, dispatch, execution, blocker_repair, close_or_split, momentum_review, project_management, closeout.
training_record_shape.next_action: The next bounded action TOD should take.
training_record_shape.reason: Why that successor action is correct.
training_record_shape.required_evidence: What proof would show the next action worked.
training_record_shape.escalation_path: TOD/MIM/Codex/external/Dave path if the next action fails or requires authority.

scoring: Did the action move the project?
rules: No terminal state without a successor state.
Completed work requires closeout or regression watch.
Blocked work requires unblock, reclassify, escalate, or archive.
Rejected work requires contract repair or corrected replay.
Missing acceptance requires definition of done before progress claims.
Scope-expanded work requires follow-on project split.
Moving work requires executing the current driving task and publishing evidence.

first_implementation.surface: Studio Projects API and Projects table
first_implementation.behavior: Each project receives a candidate TOD next action derived from its current completion pressure, scope state, momentum, blocker, and driving task.

acceptance_criteria: Every non-deleted project exposes a TOD next-action candidate.
Candidate includes lane, next action, confidence, reason, required evidence, and escalation path.
Automatic interventions use the same candidate selector.
The Projects page surfaces the candidate action without adding static explanatory filler.
Next training pass extracts real situation/outcome/next-action examples from existing project events and TOD artifacts.
